ownership.quote: Founded by Shahul ES and Jithin James, the creators of Ragas, Vibrant Labs benchmarks and builds environments for long-horizon agents. Backed by YCombinator, Heavybit, PioneerFund, and Hike Ventures.

stage.quote: We were accepted into YCombinator on that premise and received a $2.5M pre-seed round to build whatever comes next.
stage.note: The company (originally Exploding Gradients / Ragas) previously raised a small seed noted by Tracxn (~$500K, 2024); the $2.5M pre-seed announced Nov 2025 under the Vibrant Labs rebrand is the last priced round found.

total_funding_usd.basis: company blog post announcing the pre-seed round amount; no later round found
